name: CapCut
tagline: A video editor for phone, desktop and web with AI captions, background removal, effects and templates.
about: CapCut is a video editor from ByteDance built for social video. AI handles captions, cut-outs and effects, and there is a large library of templates and sounds.
pros: Auto-captions and one-tap effects speed up short-form editing.
Huge library of templates, sounds and effects.
cons: Many newer AI features need CapCut Pro.
